Which environmental laws are enforced in the most EPA cases?
SELECT statute_code, count(DISTINCT case_number) AS cases FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_law_sections WHERE statute_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In patent suits, who usually asks for a jury: plaintiffs, defendants or both?
SELECT jury_demand, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which federal departments funded the research behind the most granted patents?
SELECT level_one AS department, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_gov_interest_org GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many New Yorkers were admitted for complications of diabetes in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS stays FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Diabetes mellitus with complications%'
Which federal agencies have barred the most companies from contracting?
SELECT excluding_agency, count(*) AS exclusions FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions WHERE classification <> 'Individual' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the systematic IUPAC name for aspirin?
SELECT c1 AS iupac_name FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_iupac WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which hospitals in Westchester County treated the most heart attack patients?

SELECT facility_name, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Westchester' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registered trials mention COVID in their title?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE lower(brief_title) LIKE '%covid%'
Which SEC forms were filed most often in 2025?
SELECT form, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings WHERE substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do federal contract wage rates for registered nurses compare with those for licensed practical nurses?

SELECT CASE WHEN occupation_title LIKE 'Registered Nurse%' THEN 'registered nurse' ELSE 'licensed practical nurse' END AS occupation, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates WHERE occupation_title LIKE 'Registered Nurse%' OR occupation_title LIKE 'Licensed Practical Nurse%' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which states had the largest current-dollar GDP in the first quarter of 2025?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y2025_q1 AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_sqgdp1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent attorneys and agents are listed as active?
SELECT count(DISTINCT atty_registration_number) AS practitioners FROM govblock_patents.patex_attorney_agent_25 WHERE atty_active_indicator = 'ACTIVE'
Which companies reported the largest income tax expense for 2023?

SELECT entity_name, max(try_cast(val AS double)) AS income_tax FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept IN ('IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit') AND frame = 'CY2023' AND unit = 'USD' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many databases does UniChem cross-reference?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_source
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Judgment Fund payments were made under Title VII discrimination claims?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.jfics_congress_report WHERE principal_citation_desc LIKE 'Title VII%'
Which New York State agencies have the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE gov = 'NYS' AND agency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average measured lipophilicity in the lipophilicity benchmark?
Which colleges enroll the most undergraduates?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(ugds AS double) AS undergraduates FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many collective membership marks, like those of clubs and unions, are on file?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(coll_memb_mark_in AS varchar) = '1'
Under what light conditions did most fatal crashes happen in 2022?
SELECT lgt_condname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Zenodo physics and chemistry records were published each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT publication_year, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE try_cast(publication_year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which drugs reach the most Medicare Part D patients?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT brnd_name, try_cast(tot_benes AS double) AS beneficiaries FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average congestion component of New York City's real-time price in 2010?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone
SELECT avg(try_cast(marginal_cost_congestion_mwh AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2010'
Which counties grew fastest in population from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT geoname, round(100.0 * (try_cast(_2024 AS double) / try_cast(_2010 AS double) - 1), 1) AS growth_percent FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '2' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' AND try_cast(_2010 AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hip fractures did New York hospitals treat in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS stays FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Fracture of neck of femur%'
Which European countries get the most out of their onshore wind on average?
SELECT country, avg(try_cast(cf AS double)) AS avg_capacity_factor FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_pecd_pecd_country_onshore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many HVAC contract opportunities were posted for places in New Jersey?
SELECT count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE naicscode = '238220' AND popstate = 'NJ'
Which states' power plants emitted the most nitrogen oxides in 2022?
SELECT state, sum(nox_mass_lbs) AS nox_lbs FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) = 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many preprints are in the ChemRxiv collection?
SELECT count(*) AS preprints FROM govblock_scholarly.chemrxiv_items
Which New York nonprofits bring in the most revenue?
SELECT name, city, try_cast(revenue_amt AS double) AS revenue FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf WHERE state = 'NY' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of jobs in Rhode Island change from 2007 to 2019?
SELECT year, sum(c000) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'ri' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year IN (2007, 2019) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which grid operators had the highest peak demand in July 2023?

SELECT replace(split_part(series_id, '.', 2), '-ALL', '') AS balancing_authority, max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'EBA.%-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '202307%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many manufacturing jobs were in Wayne County, Michigan, in 2019?
SELECT sum(cns05) AS total FROM govblock_labor.lodes_wac WHERE state = 'mi' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '26163'
Which counties are split among the most ZIP code areas?
SELECT namelsad_county_20, geoid_county_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pounds of chemicals went into landfills in Pennsylvania in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(_57_551_landfills AS double)) AS landfill_pounds FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _8_st = 'PA' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2021'
Which stock exchanges list the most companies that file with the SEC?

SELECT json_extract_scalar(exchanges, '$[0]') AS exchange, count(*) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE json_extract_scalar(exchanges, '$[0]') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the Texas grid's generation came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ERCO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
